'''Emita''' was a small [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. It contained [[Emita Spaceport|one]] of Chandrila's three full [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and was the only region of the planet in which industrial manufacturing was permitted. The majority of the [[Gladean State Parks]], recreational facilities supported by a [[Chandrilan industrial tax|tax]] on industry, were located in the city.

==Description==
[[File:Chandrila-AoRCR.png|thumb|right|200px|Emita was located on the planet Chandrila.]]
Emita was a small<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|232|Emita}}</ref> [[City/Legends|city]] located on the [[Ananta]] continent of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The city contained the [[Emita Spaceport]], one of<ref name="Strongholds" /> the three fully equipped [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] facilities on the planet.<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

The only area of the planet zoned for industrial manufacturing, Emita was home to the manufacturing company [[ChandrilTech]]. The corporation operated multiple facilities in the city, including a [[ChandrilTech warehouse|warehouse]], its primary [[ChandrilTech main factory|factory]], multiple retail shops and show floors, and its [[ChandrilTech headquarters spire|headquarters]], which was a tall spire. The industry based in the city was required to conform to strict environmental regulations, which discouraged outside investment in the region but allowed [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Chandrilan/Legends|Chandrilans]] to create a number of advancements in clean manufacturing. Despite its industry, Emita was home to most of the [[Gladean State Parks]], a collection of recreational and natural sites that was spread across the planet. The [[Gladean Arboretum]] and [[Gladean Gardens Botanical Park of Chandrila]] were two such parks. As with the other parks, both attracted tourists from around the [[Ringali Shell]] region of the Core Worlds and beyond.<ref name="Strongholds" />

The Emita Spaceport was the only one on its continent and the smallest of Chandrila's three spaceports. Large amounts of [[Grain/Legends|grain]] grown in the northern part of [[Chandrila's eastern continent]] moved through the spaceport, as did many [[Star/Legends|interstellar]] travelers who planned to attend the [[Chandrilan Academy of Sciences]]&mdash;a [[University/Legends|college]] located in Emita that attracted students from around the Core Worlds. A [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] service carried passengers across the [[Emerald Ocean]] to Chandrila's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==History==
[[Millennium/Legends|Thousands]] of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the city was led by [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Gladean]]. Gladean levied a [[Chandrilan industrial tax|tax]] on industrial operations on Chandrila, using a complex formula to determine how much companies would be charged; the [[Currency/Legends|money]] that was collected was placed in the [[Gladean State Parks Fund]] and distributed to parks around the planet. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], the city's governor was named [[Dehsea]].<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Inhabitants==
The Chandrilan Academy of Science, located in Emita, attracted many intelligent [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] from around the Core Worlds to the city.<ref name="Strongholds" />

==Behind the scenes==
Emita was first mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
